newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Waterford Foods to consider Avonmore offer Friday.
newsitem.headline: Waterford Foods to consider Avonmore offer Friday.

text.p: The boards of Waterford Foods and Waterford Co-Op are to meet on Friday in Dungarvan to consider clarification of merger proposals received from Avonmore Foods Plc, a spokeswoman for the company told Reuters on Thursday.

Avonmore formally made an offer for Waterford last month, offering a two-for-one share swap for the group. The merger, if approved, would create a new group with turnover in excess of 2.5 billion Irish pounds.
But it must first be ratified by 75 percent of Waterford Co-Op members who own 67 percent of the company's shares.
Following a board meeting to consider the offer on April 18, Waterford sought further clarification of Avonmore's offer.
